# conflict strategy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:conflictStrategy`](gmeow-conflictStrategy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/conflictStrategy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

How a rights statement resolves a permission/prohibition conflict over the same action ([odrl:conflict](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/conflict)): [`gmeow:conflictPerm`](../individuals/gmeow-conflictPerm.md) (permission wins), [`gmeow:conflictProhibit`](../individuals/gmeow-conflictProhibit.md) (prohibition wins), [`gmeow:conflictInvalid`](../individuals/gmeow-conflictInvalid.md) (the policy is void). Functional.
